# notes: R9566 holds TWO texts. (a) Despatch No. 3874, Paris 1 Dec 1816, signed Castelcicala: pages p3 (first page, with interlinear Italian decipherment of its first ~10 lines), p2 (headed '2.'), p4 (end, clear close and signature); neat hand with many overbars (line-initial bars in p2 may be line-start marks rather than group marks). (b) p1, p5, p6: a different hand, no header, date or signature anywhere (a fragment/another despatch). Groups with an extra digit as written: 22111, 80601, 214600, 17390, 21900, 18900, 19300, 14000, 11378, 63013, 18950, 17900, 8740, 6620, 18180, 19990, 18430, 14410. Interlinear words are placed loosely over the groups; line-for-line alignment given, not group-for-group.
